fn Factorial(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else (n * Factorial((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (Factorial(0) == 1)
  example (Factorial(2) == 2)
{
  if (n == 0) then 1 else (n * Factorial((n - 1)))
}

fn IterativeFactorial(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == Factorial(n))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (IterativeFactorial(0) == 0)
{
  0
}
